title: Kenyan Matcha Chicken Skewers
description: A vibrant twist on traditional Kenyan chicken, featuring the earthy taste of matcha. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together matcha powder, crushed vibrant pepper, and a pinch of salt.
Add chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the matcha mixture.
Thread chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the chicken with olive oil and season with salt.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, heat the Kenyan-style BBQ sauce in a small saucepan over low heat.
Once the chicken is cooked, brush with the BBQ sauce and serve hot.
Serve with your choice of sides, such as a salad or roasted vegetables.
